components.css: .ds-header{display:grid;min-height:70px;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;border-bottom:2px solid #ffea00;background:#000}.ds-brand,.ds-download{display:flex;min-height:68px;align-items:center;padding:0 clamp(16px,2vw,32px);font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-brand{color:#ffea00;font-size:2rem}.ds-download{border-left:2px solid #ffea00;background:#ffea00;color:#000;font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-download:hover,.ds-download:focus-visible{background:#00e6ef}.ds-brand:focus-visible,.ds-download:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:-5px}

components.description: A strong color-band chapter divider with one clear title.

components.name: Broadcast Proof Panel
components.description: A restrained product proof with one yellow signal rail, compact metadata, and an undistracted image surface.
components.css: .ds-proof{margin:0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-top:5px solid #ffea00;border-radius:0;background:#050505;color:#fff;font-family:'Share Tech Mono',ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-proof header{display:flex;min-height:34px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 12px;color:#bfc3c5;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-proof header>:last-child{padding:0 5px;background:#00e24b;color:#000}.ds-proof-stage{display:grid;min-height:160px;place-items:center;border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:#050505;color:#bfc3c5}.ds-proof figcaption{padding:11px 12px;color:#00e6ef;font-size:.9rem}.ds-proof:focus-within{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
Workroom presents parallel development as a focused live service: terse, exact, high-contrast, and always visibly in progress. Its visual language borrows the strongest universal qualities of broadcast teletext—hard color bands, condensed display type, block geometry, and dense information framing—without depending on page numbers or specialist teletext vocabulary.

The system refuses soft, centered SaaS polish. It is intentionally flat, rectilinear, and cell-aligned. Visual personality comes from role-specific signal colors and the rhythm of hard divisions, not gradients, glass, rounded cards, stock illustrations, or decorative shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Broadcast-black fields divided by exact, high-contrast rules.
Fixed yellow, cyan, green, red, and blue roles; color communicates channel and state.
Smooth condensed display type paired with readable monospaced copy.
Clear labels, block mosaics, and square marks.
Dense on wide screens, structurally stacked on narrow screens without losing the lattice.
Motion is sparse, discrete, and non-essential.

rules.name: The Fixed Channel Rule
rules.body: Yellow means brand/action, cyan means interaction/splits, green means review/files, red means alert, and blue means structural broadcast band; do not casually swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Black Field Rule
rules.body: Bright signal colors live on black or in flat full-color bands. Do not dilute them into pastel tints or soft neutral cards.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for display, sectional, and action moments; use Share Tech Mono for readable information. Never introduce a third expressive face.

rules.name: The Broadcast-Height Rule
rules.body: Display lines are compact and forceful, but retain enough leading for Barlow Condensed's smooth letterforms. Never use the display face for paragraphs.

rules.name: The Broadcast Grid Rule
rules.body: Every major region should feel clearly structured by row, column, or color channel—even after responsive stacking.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate through rules, fills, and cell patterns. Do not add ambient shadows, soft elevation, glass blur, or neumorphic relief.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Buttons, panels, chips, disclosures, tabs, and frames remain rectangular. A rounded control belongs to another visual world.

rules.name: The Countable Geometry Rule
rules.body: Decorative forms should resolve into an obvious small grid or orthogonal path rather than organic blobs.

dos: Do preserve fixed semantic color roles across actions, channels, diagrams, and component states.
Do use hard borders and grid alignment to make every region feel clearly structured.
Do keep Barlow Condensed to short, high-impact copy and Share Tech Mono to readable content.
Do preserve minimum 48px interactive targets on narrow screens and the 3px white focus outline.
Do disable smooth scrolling when reduced motion is requested.
Do render the compact square mark from crisp, countable geometry.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, pill chips, gradients, glass, glows, or drop shadows.
Don't soften the palette into pastels, invent nearby shades for decoration, or reassign channel colors arbitrarily.
Don't center every section into a generic hero stack; use unequal grids, restrained product proof, and clear labels.
Don't animate essential content or make state depend on motion.
Don't replace the self-hosted type pairing with generic geometric sans typography.
Don't require knowledge of teletext conventions; broadcast cues must remain understandable in plain language.
